note: What synthetic member A says on each voice screen. Written by us; simulates on-device dictation.

scripts.voice_goals: Mostly I want more energy. I'm happy where I am, so I'd like to stay where I am. My doctor mentioned prediabetes at my last check-up, so I want to get ahead of that. The hard part is that my schedule keeps changing, and half the time I'm not sure what to eat. I usually eat three times a day.
scripts.voice_food: I'm vegetarian. Lactose upsets my stomach, so I keep away from dairy. I'd rather avoid mushrooms. At home we cook mostly South Asian food, and I love Mediterranean too.
scripts.voice_kitchen: I do most of the cooking myself. On weeknights I have about 15 to 30 minutes for dinner. Our food budget feels comfortable. We order in once or twice a week. I take vitamin D every morning. Nothing else really.
